name: quality-inspection-nonconformance
description: Manufacturing Wave 1 Cowork plugin: clear an inspection lot. Reads part specs, drawings, inspection plans, CoC and measurement exports; compares actual measurements against tolerances (deterministic tolerance_check, with CoC-vs-measurement cross-check); grades each defect by severity and disposition (deterministic defect_grade rules engine); drafts the nonconformance report with every call cited to the spec. Draft-first; document-grounded. Ends at NCR creation and hands off to Quality Incident & CAPA (Wave 2).
